detail.longDescription: AI agents were the promise of 2024, the hype of 2025, and the expectation of 2026 and beyond. The category has matured, and a handful of agents are ready to use out of the box, with tool access, task completion, and guardrails for the data they touch. I've spent a lot of time with AI agents, and I have some opinions about which ones stand out.
